Method of Attack: Data breach and data extortion by threatening to publish or sell stolen data
Impersonation of ransomware and data extortion gangs in emails
Threatening distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks if demands are not met
Social engineering extortion scams (phantom incident extortion)
Use of stolen data or data from ransomware victim leak sites to support extortion claims
Discoverer: Kroll corporate investigation and risk consulting firm
Impacted Systems: U.S. companies targeted by data breaches and ransomware attacks
Organizations previously victimized by ransomware attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Emails impersonating Silent Ransom Group (SRG), Surtr ransomware group, and Luna Moth
Claims of stolen data volumes (e.g., 600GB of essential data)
Threat messages sent to former employees' email addresses
Use of ransomware victim data leak sites and forums
